title: BrainBench Public Probe (PublicQuery)
description: The Query shape handed to adapters and agent loops — the shrunk sealed surface produced by sanitizeQuery() (eval/runner/types.ts PublicQuery). Scrubbed of every gold and classification field: no `gold`, `tier`, `tags`, `expected_output_type`, `acceptable_variants`, `known_failure_modes`, `author`. Scorers retain the full Query shape; adapters see only {id, text, as_of_date?}.

id.description: Stable probe id. Real families include q-0001 (world-v1), c13-00001 (cat13), sig-0001 (cat8).

as_of_date.description: Present for temporal queries: an ISO YYYY-MM-DD date or one of the sentinels. anyOf with a pattern (not format:date + oneOf): under draft 2020-12 `format` is annotation-only by default, so the sentinels matched BOTH former oneOf branches and failed exactly-one validation (audit data-integrity-07).
